import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Arc
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" orange = "#C66B4E" ink = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.8)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.07, 0.14, 0.88, 0.74]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-2.0, 4.25) ax.set_ylim(-0.4, 4.1) ax.axis("off")
# Schematic geometry only: the chosen drawing angle and lengths are not data. theta = np.deg2rad(28) e1 = np.array([1.0, 0.0]) e2 = np.array([0.0, 1.0]) b1 = np.array([np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)]) b2 = np.array([-np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)]) v = np.array([2.35, 2.90]) origin = np.zeros(2)
projections_A = [np.dot(v, e1) * e1, np.dot(v, e2) * e2] projections_B = [np.dot(v, b1) * b1, np.dot(v, b2) * b2]
def arrow(start, end, color, linewidth=1.4, head=10, zorder=3): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=head, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=zorder, ) ax.add_patch(patch)
# Orthogonal projection guides, color-matched to their respective frames. for projections, color in [(projections_A, blue), (projections_B, teal)]: for p in projections: ax.plot( [p[0], v[0]], [p[1], v[1]], color=color, linewidth=1.05, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), alpha=0.65, zorder=1, ) ax.plot( p[0], p[1], marker="o", markersize=3.5, markerfacecolor="white", markeredgecolor=color, markeredgewidth=1, zorder=4, )
# The physical directions stay fixed; only the coordinate basis changes. arrow(origin, 3.88 * e1, blue) arrow(origin, 3.85 * e2, blue) arrow(origin, 4.02 * b1, teal) arrow(origin, 3.85 * b2, teal)
# Unit basis vectors have the same displayed length. for direction, color in [(e1, blue), (e2, blue), (b1, teal), (b2, teal)]: arrow(origin, direction, color, linewidth=2.6, head=11, zorder=5)
# A single physical vector. arrow(origin, v, orange, linewidth=2.5, head=14, zorder=6) ax.text(v[0] + 0.10, v[1] + 0.09, r"$\mathbf{v}$", color=orange, fontsize=16)
# Positive passive-basis rotation angle. ax.add_patch(Arc( origin, 1.28, 1.28, theta1=0, theta2=np.rad2deg(theta), color=ink, linewidth=1.1, zorder=5, )) angle_label = 0.80 * np.array([np.cos(theta / 2), np.sin(theta / 2)]) ax.text(*angle_label, r"$\theta$", fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center")
# Axis names and frame identifiers. ax.text(4.00, -0.015, r"$x_A$", color=blue, va="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(0.03, 3.99, r"$y_A$", color=blue, ha="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(-0.34, 3.61, r"$\{A\}$", color=blue, fontsize=12)
xb = 4.02 * b1 yb = 3.85 * b2 ax.text(xb[0] + 0.12, xb[1] + 0.015, r"$x_B$", color=teal, va="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(yb[0] - 0.04, yb[1] + 0.15, r"$y_B$", color=teal, ha="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(-1.56, 3.14, r"$\{B\}$", color=teal, fontsize=12)
# Basis labels, separated from the angle and projection labels. ax.text(1.04, -0.20, r"$\mathbf{e}_1$", color=blue, ha="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(0.13, 1.02, r"$\mathbf{e}_2$", color=blue, va="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(1.03, 0.48, r"$\mathbf{b}_1$", color=teal, fontsize=12) ax.text(-0.60, 0.78, r"$\mathbf{b}_2$", color=teal, ha="right", fontsize=12)
# Scalar coordinates on each corresponding axis. ax.annotate(r"$v_1^{A}$", projections_A[0], xytext=(0, -16), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", color=blue, fontsize=12) ax.annotate(r"$v_2^{A}$", projections_A[1], xytext=(-10, 0), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", va="center", color=blue, fontsize=12) ax.annotate(r"$v_1^{B}$", projections_B[0], xytext=(10, -15), textcoords="offset points", ha="left", color=teal, fontsize=12) ax.annotate(r"$v_2^{B}$", projections_B[1], xytext=(-10, 2), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", va="center", color=teal, fontsize=12)
ax.plot(0, 0, "o", color=ink, markersize=3, zorder=7) ax.text(-0.09, -0.13, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=10)
fig.text(0.5, 0.95, "Passive change of basis", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, weight="medium") fig.text(0.5, 0.901, "Same physical vector · rotated coordinate frame", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color="#657786") fig.text( 0.5, 0.065, r"$\mathbf{v}=v_1^{A}\mathbf{e}_1+v_2^{A}\mathbf{e}_2" r"=v_1^{B}\mathbf{b}_1+v_2^{B}\mathbf{b}_2$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, )
